summary: Pin published procache credential guard for tests

delivery.outcome: Fresh test environments load the published procache credential guard so the credential-scope regression test passes without changing runtime dependencies.
nonGoals: No runtime dependency change; procache stays an optional runtime integration.
No weakening of the credential-scope test.
No change to the shared primary .venv or running services.

architecture.decision: Declare the test-only procache pin as a PEP 735 dependency group so installs of the published wheel are unaffected.
architecture.rollback: Revert to accepted base 0494b2d3124eb3af90807740067321b39ad5c22b; no data is migrated.

validation.evidence: All procache integration tests pass in a fresh environment, including the credential-scope test.
Wheel Requires-Dist does not include subactor-procache.
